question: Does broad independent validation at a five-player table preserve the successful three/four-player Demis correction without overcorrecting five?

demis.protectedStrength: All Compute, Research reliability, Capability, and technical threshold attainment remain canonical.
demis.bottleneck: Demis scores one Mandate at Capability 9 and 12, except Capability 12 scores the canonical two when four rivals can independently validate the result.
demis.eligibility: Reject if three/four lose the prior correction, five remains below the competitive band, or any technical realization changes materially.

requiredDiagnostics: configuration-specific faction standings at three, four, and five players
Capability 9 and 12 attainment and Mandate by threshold
Research, Scientific Method, Scaling-Law, and Capability realization
paired win-share, score, and rank delta

selectionRule.demis: Select only if Demis remains among the competitive leaders at three, moves near the four-player leading band, and returns to a viable mid-pack result at five without changing technical outputs.
selectionRule.pairedAuthority: Compare only with canonical on common seeds and interpret absolute score/rank bands because tied winners make nominal win-share parity non-additive.
selectionRule.integrity: Any integrity violation, policy fallback, unsupported-count gap, or missing realization metric rejects the probe.
selectionRule.promotion: No physical rule changes without a tracked receipt, combined-package confirmation, synchronized immutable candidate, and explicit user approval.
